summary: HUD render-resource initializer. Takes a resource type a2 in [1,5], releases any existing resource of that type via AudioResourceReleaseByType, then, per type, selects a global handle slot and screen-scaled quad dimensions. If the selected handle is empty, creates a render object with 4 textured quad vertices positioned using normalized screen dimensions this[0xE4]/this[0xE8]. Type 3 additionally allocates a 96-byte zero-filled struct, sets a bit flag at +68, builds a HUD51264.tga texture path from season directory/name globals (with byte_5EA438 fallback), loads the D3D texture, and on texture-load failure destructs and frees the struct and resets the sentinel. Returns 0 on successful creation, 1 for the default path or when a2 is outside [1,5].

operations.description: Initialize defaults: v3 = 1 (return value for default/failure) and v4 = 0x80000000 (sentinel flag passed to vertex setup).
AudioResourceReleaseByType(a2): release any existing resource of the given type before re-initializing it.
Switch on a2 dispatching types 1-5 via the jump table; the default case returns v3 immediately (1).
Type 1: select handle slot v5 = &dword_8AD398 and set quad dimensions v18 = 768.0, v12 = 256.0.
Type 2: select handle slot v5 = &dword_8AD39C and set quad dimensions v18 = 256.0, v12 = 512.0.
Type 3: select handle slot v5 = &dword_8AD3A0, set dimensions v20 = 0.0, v18 = 0.0, v15 = 1280.0, v12 = 160.0, and set v4 = -1.
Type 3: allocate 96 bytes via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper; if non-null, zero-fill via StructInitWithZeroFill; store the result into dword_8AD3AC.
Type 3: set a bit flag on the allocated struct at offset +68 (OR with 1u).

Type 3: build the texture path — use dword_5EC428 (else fallback byte_5EA438) and dword_5EC3D8 (else fallback byte_5EA438), formatted via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck into the local 128-byte buffer with format aSSS_0 and the filename aHud51264Tga.

Type 3: call D3DTextureCreation(path, 0, &unk_800004); on failure run DestructorWithConditionalFreeFlagClear(dword_8AD3AC), then if non-null EmptyStub_7470 and FreeWrapper_7bcf, zero dword_8AD3AC, and restore v4 = 0x80000000.
Type 4: select handle slot v5 = &dword_8AD3A4 and set quad dimensions v20 = 870.0, v18 = 140.0, v15 = 410.0, v12 = 220.0.
Type 5: select handle slot v5 = &flt_8AD3A8, set dimensions v18 = 0.0, v12 = 50.0, v4 = -1; the shared tail additionally sets v20 = 0.0 and v15 = 1280.0.
If the selected handle *v5 is already non-null, skip creation (already initialized) and fall through to the return.
ObjectConstructorWithAllocationAndSubInit(v5, 2, 0, 32, 64): create the render object and store its handle into the selected slot.
If the handle *v5 is now non-null, configure the four quad vertices; otherwise leave v3 at 1.
Scale the quad dimensions by the normalized screen dimensions: v21 = v20 * this[0xE4], v19 = v18 * this[0xE8], v16 = v15 * this[0xE4], v13 = v12 * this[0xE8].

Four sub_553650 calls set the quad vertices (position + UV + sentinel v4): vertex 0 at (v21, v19), vertex 1 at (v21, v13+v19), vertex 2 at (v16+v21, v13+v19), vertex 3 at (v16+v21, v19), each with UV coordinates 1.0/0.0/1.0 combos.
Type 3 only: after quad setup, call SetterWrites0x10Returns0(dword_8AD3AC).
Set v3 = 0 on successful creation and return v3 (0 success, 1 default/skip/out-of-range).
